stations.title: Ines
stations.note: She counts the shelf each morning.

stations.title: Ines
stations.text: What to pour, and totals that agree.

captions: Every candle has a card now. Ines counts the shelf and asks what to pour next.
She adds the note up on her phone and gets a different total every time.
You go through objects and lists of cards to count, find, list and add up.
The shelf count comes back as one total and a list of the scents to pour.
Objects can be gone through now, key by key and card by card.
